scope: Independent bounded development review of strict cohort selection, existing-output preservation, max_tasks semantics and checkpoint resume/retry. No model/provider/network calls, no repository edits, not formal red team or clinical validation.
resolved_boundary: Case-insensitive task ID output collision was raised during static review; owner added a narrow tested rejection. Final independent casefold check passes.
semantics_confirmed: Complete YAML/YML catalog and all requested IDs validated before provider/output, including malformed/duplicate/unsafe rows outside cap.
Exact positive integer counts reject booleans/floats; empty/repeated/missing selections fail.
Invalid requests preserve an existing artifact tree byte-for-byte and create no new output.
All and explicit selections use task-ID sorting; max_tasks applies after full validation and may exceed selected count.
max1 to max2 to max1 retains prior immutable trajectories, executes only newly selected tasks, and uses current selected denominator.
Identical resume leaves output bytes unchanged; altered selected task is refused by checkpoint provenance checks.
Error trials remain cached unless explicitly retried; retries append new trajectory/log evidence without replacing originals.
limits: Execution uses offline client/agent stubs and empty in-memory worlds; it verifies orchestration/selection semantics, not inference or clinical correctness.
Environment digest was held constant in resume probes to isolate cohort changes from normal source-version checkpoint invalidation.
Strict loading provides stated cohort integrity checks, not full authored-task JSON Schema or clinical satisfiability validation.
No filesystem mutation races or process/crash durability claims were tested.
